jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game sprite atlas matching polished painted dimensional toy-racing illustration style, gentle realistic textures with bold readable silhouettes. Transparent background. EXACT3columns by2rows equal SQUARE cells, landscape3:2, generous transparent gutters and padding. All figures face RIGHT side three-quarter. TOP ROW: same SMALL cute bright GREEN frog (round eyes, friendly smile) in3 poses: sitting relaxed; crouched legs ready tohop; mid-leap stretched little legs. BOTTOM ROW: same BIGGER warty OLIVE frog with a grumpy silly expression (represents a troll), same3 poses sitting/crouched/mid-leap. Keep size consistent within each row, big frog about1.4times small frog. Full feet and toes visible safely inside all cells. No scenery, floors, cast shadows, text, grid or other props. Friendly and child-appropriate, never scary.

Use case: stylized-concept. Three-frame surfing WAVE animation for polished painted dimensional doll-racing game. Transparent background. EXACTLY3columns in1row, each frame an equal SQUARE panel, horizontal3:1 sheet with broad transparent outer margins and gutters. Each panel contains the SAME broad low curling turquoise surfing wave with pearly WHITE FOAM, curling and advancing toward RIGHT. Three subtly successive curl/foam shapes for a smooth repeating loop. Keep base level, width and wave height consistent across frames, broad horizontal wave silhouette about3 times as wide as tall. Entire wave silhouette fully visible with no cropping or overlap. Glossy painted storybook water, soft dimension and clear readable foam. No surfer, board, doll, scenery, ground, lettering, grid, cast shadows or extra props. Each wave sits low inside its cell with safe padding underneath.

Use case: stylized-concept. Toy-racing game sprite atlas, polished painted dimensional tin-toy style with shiny highlights and clean readable outlines. True transparent background. EXACT3columns by2rows equal SQUARE cells, landscape3:2, generous clear gutters and outer padding. All cars face RIGHT, side view with slight top surface visible. TOP ROW: same RED vintage tin RACE CAR, chunky black wheels and a BIG silver WIND-UP KEY on top, three successive wheel/key rotation phases, same body position and scale. BOTTOM ROW: same YELLOW vintage tin BUS with windows, chunky black wheels and BIG silver WIND-UP KEY on top, three successive wheel/key rotation phases, same body position/scale. Friendly toy details, no readable text/logos. Both vehicles rest level with wheels aligned along common low baseline. Entire vehicle, both wheels and rotating key visible within every cell. No ground, cast shadows, scene, labels, grid, flames or extra props.

Use case: style-transfer. Transparent browser racing game enemy animation atlas. Match the original monster sprite reference's polished PAINTED slightly photoreal textured 3D game rendering, full-body scale and pose layout, while replacing the troll with: Tall lanky jack-o'-lantern scarecrow, goofy carved pumpkin grin with warm inner glow, patched plaid shirt, denim overalls, floppy straw hat, straw cuffs/collar. Final defeated pose is an EMPTY heap of his clothes and straw with pumpkin head sitting on top, no standing body. Child-friendly spooky-silly charm. EXACT3 columns x4 rows of equal SQUARE cells, portrait3:4. Faces RIGHT like reference; game mirrors when needed. Preserve coherent anatomy, head size, clothing and surface finish across all twelve figures. All complete figures at consistent physical scale within cells, at most75%cell height/width, lots of transparent padding/gutters. Row1 three subtly varied upright idle-sway poses. Row2 three distinct walking poses (left foot forward, feet crossing, right foot forward). Row3 exactly match the original troll's action silhouettes and hand positions: lunge/grab with BOTH hands reaching forward RIGHT at chest height; lift with empty hands raised curved OVERHEAD; throw with arms flung forward RIGHT. No doll or held object; game draws victim separately. Row4: falling backwards LEFT with arms up and feet forward RIGHT; collapsing in a crumple on ground; final defeated pile as described. Keep same body direction and visual mass as matching reference frames. Each figure including hat, raised hands, shoes, scarf and pile fully visible within its cell, never clipped or crossing into adjacent slots. No floor, ground shadow, text, gridlines, extra figures or scenery.
